# @bangbang93/opencode-bash-file-read-guard

An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) plugin that keeps the model from reading files with `cat`, `head` and `tail`.

OpenCode's `read` tool is the better way to read a file: it numbers each line, reads large files in sections, and
opens images and PDFs. When the model runs a plain `cat FILE`, `head [-n N] FILE` or `tail [-n N] FILE`, the plugin
blocks the command and returns that advice as the tool's error, so the model switches to `read`.

## Install

Add the package to `plugins` in `opencode.jsonc`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["@bangbang93/opencode-bash-file-read-guard@0.1.0"]
}
```

To run a checkout of the repository instead, point the entry at `packages/bash-file-read-guard`.

## Behavior

- Only the shell tool is watched, and only a command that is `cat`, `head` or `tail` and one file, nothing else.
- Anything else runs as usual: another option, several files, a pipe, or a second command in the same line.
- The command does not run when it is blocked.

## Disable

Add `"-bash-file-read-guard"` to the `plugins` array.

## License

MIT. [NOTICE.md](./NOTICE.md) lists what this plugin derives from.

# Notice

This plugin re-implements the bash-file-read-guard hook of
[oh-my-openagent](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent) 5.1.24 for the OpenCode V2 plugin API.

## Sources

- Hook design: `packages/omo-opencode/src/hooks/bash-file-read-guard.ts` of oh-my-openagent 5.1.24, commit
  `fda8eb83630682c22a18e06b51b7366f843858b9` (Sustainable Use License v1.0). No source text from that package is
  included here.

## Differences from the oh-my-openagent hook

- Built on `ctx.tool.hook("execute.before")`. The hook throws, so OpenCode fails the call with the warning as its
  error and the command does not run.
- OpenCode 2.4 registers the bash tool as `shell`, so that name is checked as well.
- The warning is reworded: OpenCode's `read` tool has no hash anchors.

## Dependencies

- `@opencode/plugin` must stay compatible with the OpenCode release that loads the plugin.

## Disable

Add `"-bash-file-read-guard"` to the `plugins` array in `opencode.jsonc`.
